deals.headline: NFL owners approve Tom Brady and Tom Wagner buying 10% of the Raiders
deals.investor: Tom Brady and Tom Wagner (Knighthead Capital Management co-founder)
deals.summary: Owners unanimously approved Brady and Knighthead co-founder Tom Wagner buying 10% from Mark Davis. No terms were disclosed; the Review-Journal cites CNBC reporting a valuation of about $3.5 billion and roughly $220 million of equity (reported, not recorded here as stated terms).

deals.summary: Silver Lake co-CEO Egon Durban and Discovery Land founder Michael Meldman each agreed to buy 7.5% at a $6.5bn valuation, per SBJ citing Bloomberg.

deals.evidence: Egon Durban purchased a 3.5% stake in the team at an $11 billion valuation.
deals.headline: NFL approves Durban's 3.5% Raiders purchase at $11bn and a succession option
deals.summary: Owners approved Durban buying 3.5% at an $11bn valuation and Mark Davis' succession plan giving Durban the option to buy the controlling stake if Davis sells.

deals.headline: First Football sells its 25% of the Raiders to a Durban-led group

deals.summary: Owners approved the sale of just over 25% held since 2007 by First Football; Durban rose to 22%, Meldman to 12.9%, with Dell 5.3%, Baratta 1.7%, Emanuel 1.4% and Shapiro 0.6%. SBJ (citing Bloomberg) reports the deal values the team at $9.9bn.

notes: US teams publish no accounts: revenue and operating income are Forbes estimates for the 2025 season (list of 9 Sep 2026, via Wayback since forbes.com refuses scripted fetches); player expenses are from Forbes' team profile calculated August 2025 (2024 season). Forbes' profile put debt/value at 17% (2025) but no amount, so net_debt is blank. All minority partners invest personally (Durban is Silver Lake co-CEO, Wagner Knighthead co-founder, Baratta a Blackstone executive whom the Review-Journal calls 'founder'); no fund or institution holds a stake on any page read. Brady's and Wagner's individual shares of their 10% are not stated on a page read, nor whether the May 2026 percentages for Durban/Meldman include the March 3.5%. Sandra Douglass Morgan's bio still says she was named President in 2022, but she is not on the current executive list, so no chief executive besides the owner is recorded. Legal entity, attendance and social counts not found on a citable page. Kits are league-wide Nike; the NFL has no shirt sponsor.

ownership_summary: Mark Davis is the controlling owner (36% per the Review-Journal, May 2026), having taken over on Al Davis' death in 2011. Minority partners since 2024 include Silver Lake co-CEO Egon Durban (22%, with an NFL-approved option to buy control if Davis sells), Discovery Land founder Michael Meldman (12.9%), Michael Dell (5.3%), Blackstone's Joseph Baratta (1.7%), Ari Emanuel (1.4%), Mark Shapiro (0.6%), and Tom Brady with Knighthead Capital co-founder Tom Wagner (10% together, 2024). All are individuals investing personally; no fund holds a stake.
